what_this_is: The Workshop row for Stripe's account read (GET /v1/account). One http call, with the Stripe secret key from the vault placed as a bearer header on api.stripe.com only. Reads only.

payload.label: Read my Stripe account
payload.job: Read the Stripe account's own business profile: the company name, its address state and country, the business type and the profile name, so a legal entity can be checked against Stripe's own record
payload.description: Reads GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/account with the Stripe secret key the caller names by key_name (a vault entry name given as input, never stored in this row). Reads only; changes nothing. Shows only company name, address state and country, business type and profile name, and never the key.

key_name.description: The name of the vault entry that holds the Stripe secret key to read the account with. The caller names it; the row names no key.
